svg.title: SC Deûle
svg.desc: Sporting Club de la Deûle (FR-5), Lille — Football Architect. Symmetric hexagonal shield, ivory frame, Lille civic belfry and architecture, riverboat on the Deûle, name lettering and floral heraldic ornament. Approved colors only: #00384C and #F1EEE5. Editable layers and named object groups.
